description: An expander giving Stochastic Sequencer 4 a separate jack for each of its 32 steps; it goes immediately to the right of that module

params.text: Picks which of the four sequences the jacks carry, or All, which gives each column the first eight steps of one sequence
Switches that column of jacks between gates and not gates

outputs.text: Fires 10V when Stochastic Sequencer 4 reaches that step and its slider wins its probability roll

notes: the expander does nothing on its own: it must be placed immediately to the right of a Stochastic Sequencer 4, whose steps its jacks then carry.
